response.text:
The Build Plate’s drawing and orbitable 3D model are attached below. [cite: D-026/part]

**The model has not been shown to match the drawing.** Its verification state is **FAILED** and it requires manual approval; it is a reconstruction from the 2D drawing, not the original CAD. [cite: D-026/model/verification]

The drawing has two possible thickness readings, **15 mm** and **25 mm**; the model examples use 15 mm (A) and 25 mm (B). They are possible readings, not a determination of which is correct. [cite: D-026/template/thickness, D-026/model/verification] The A/B viewer visualizes both possibilities; it does not tell which is right. [cite: D-026/part]

The drawing weight is **7,822.5 g**. [cite: D-026/drawing/weight_g] Calculated model weights are **5,816.8551 g** (A) and **9,694.7586 g** (B), using approximate density assumptions of **7.9 g/cm³** for stainless steel and **7.85 g/cm³** for steel; those density references are outside the dataset. Neither example passes the weight check. [cite: D-026/model/verification] Hole and slot details are omitted while awaiting review. [cite: D-026/model/verification] AI-sourced only, not yet reviewed; may contain errors. [cite: D-026/model/verification]
